deletion_trials.reason: Removing the replacement restores the invalid inference sqrt(a^2)=a, which fails for negative a because sqrt denotes the nonnegative square root.

reason: For every real a, |a| is nonnegative and |a|^2=a^2. Thus |a| is exactly the nonnegative square root of a^2, so sqrt(a^2)=|a|. The replacement changes only the failed node and retains the stated real-number domain and theorem.
